name: umbra
description: A private, unreleased local AI application being developed on Apple Silicon with MLX. A working prototype exists, but there is no public build or supported release yet.

name: gate
description: An experimental local CLI for finding secret-like patterns in source files and git history. It can install a repository-local pre-commit hook and attempt bounded source rewrites. Pattern matching can produce false positives and misses.

name: vexes
description: Experimental local CLI for OSV advisory matches plus heuristic npm/PyPI supply-chain evidence. Findings are review signals, not safety verdicts, and incomplete checks fail visibly.

name: mcp-librarian
description: Experimental MCP server for a local Markdown skill library. BM25 search is local; web research and pack operations are explicit network paths. Ed25519 status is recorded during indexing, but load responses do not enforce it.
